Must Have Skills
  • Strong expertise in B2B Sales process transformation, covering end-to-end Sales process steps such as Lead Management, Lead Qualification, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Account Management, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contract Management, Order Management, and Sales Operations.

Job Summary
As a Manager - B2B Sales Transformation & Process Excellence, you will lead the design and transformation of end-to-end B2B Sales processes for clients across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
You will own the process transformation design cycle-from understanding the client''s current-state Sales processes and assessing industry, market, technology, and competitive forces, through defining future-state processes and operating models, to developing implementation and adoption approaches. You will bring strong knowledge of key Sales process steps, including Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, Account Management, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Sales Operations. You will also assess how Sales platforms and applications enable these processes and identify opportunities for platform optimization, digital transformation, automation, and AI/GenAI integration.
The role requires strong consulting leadership, including client workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, executive communication, team management, and delivery ownership. You will lead and coach practitioners, ensure quality of deliverables, and build reusable methodologies and assets. You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities, including opportunity shaping, solution development, proposal responses, process narratives, capability presentations, and client presentations.
As part of AI-led transformation, you will apply AX Design principles to consider the intersection of human, AI agent, and process. Future-state process designs should define where AI agents operate autonomously, where human intervention is required, escalation triggers, controls, and the quality of human-agent handoffs.

B2B Sales Process Transformation
  • Lead end-to-end B2B Sales process transformation initiatives across multiple Sales process steps and functional areas.
  • Assess current-state processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, control gaps, manual activities, duplication, and opportunities for standardization and automation.

  • Drive transformation across key Sales processes including:
  • Lead Management & Qualification
  • Lead-to-Opportunity
  • Opportunity Management
  • Pipeline Management
  • Account Management
  • Sales Forecasting & Planning
  • CPQ & Deal Management
  • Contract Management
  • Order Management
  • Sales Operations & Revenue Operations
  • Connect process design with people, technology, data, governance, and operating model changes.
  • Develop transformation roadmaps, process specifications, business requirements, operating models, and implementation recommendations.
Sales Platforms & Applications

  • Support transformation initiatives involving CRM/Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, Sales Planning, Forecasting, Deal Management, Incentive Compensation, Order Management, and Revenue Management platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform adoption, integration, automation, data quality, user experience, and process effectiveness.
  • Lead process visualization and documentation using Microsoft Visio and other process mapping/modeling tools.
  • Work closely with business and technology teams to translate process requirements into platform and solution requirements.
Client Leadership & Workshops

Writing SQL to validate data is not optional here - it is the primary tool for most of your testing.
The right candidate takes personal ownership of quality outcomes - not just identifying problems, but partnering with engineering to drive them to resolution. No bugs made it to production on my watch is not a goal, it s a standard. This is a hybrid manual and automation role. SQL-based data validation and API test coverage are the priority automation surfaces; UI automation is secondary. AI will be a core part of how you work across every aspect of quality engineering.
Responsibilities
Quality Ownership Test Execution
  • Own the quality of the Reporting/BI team s deliverables - from requirements review through release - ensuring nothing ships without adequate test coverage across functional, data accuracy, performance, and non-functional scenarios.
  • Define, document, and execute test plans and test cases for new reporting features, SQL changes, BI enhancements, and bug fixes - covering report output correctness, data transformation accuracy, edge cases, regression, security, and non-functional scenarios.
  • Identify test conditions from user stories, reporting specifications, and requirements documents - including positive, negative, boundary, hierarchical data traversal, aggregation correctness, and null handling scenarios.
  • Execute test cases, document results, track defects, and own them through to resolution - partnering with engineers and product management to ensure nothing falls through the cracks. Identifying a problem is the beginning, not the end.
  • Participate actively in sprint ceremonies - planning, refinement, standups, demos, and retrospectives - as the quality voice of the team.
  • Collaborate with the Principal QA Lead and Sr Engineering Manager - QA Standards to maintain consistent quality standards across scrum teams.
SQL Data Accuracy Validation
  • Write Oracle SQL and PL/SQL queries to validate report output against source data - verifying row counts, field-level accuracy, aggregation correctness, financial calculations, and referential integrity. This is the primary testing tool for this team.
  • Design and execute data accuracy test strategies for complex, non-flattened hierarchical data models - validating that reporting queries traverse hierarchies correctly and produce accurate results across all nodes and rollup levels.
  • Validate SQL and PL/SQL changes - stored procedures, packages, views, and query modifications - ensuring correctness, expected performance characteristics, and no unintended side effects on existing report output.
  • Identify and document data discrepancies clearly - providing engineers with precise SQL evidence that isolates where in the data pipeline a calculation or transformation is producing incorrect results.
  • Validate query performance benchmarks as part of definition of done - confirming that new or modified queries meet the team s performance standards and do not introduce regression in report responsiveness.
Reporting BI Output Testing
  • Test end-to-end report output fidelity - validating that what is displayed in a report or BI dashboard accurately reflects the underlying data, with correct formatting, correct totals, correct filtering behavior, and correct drill-down results.
  • Validate Logi Analytics (Logi Symphony) report and dashboard implementations - testing report rendering, parameter handling, data binding, conditional logic, and export output against expected data.
  • Test report configuration and parameterization - verifying that user-selectable filters, date ranges, grouping options, and report variants produce correct, consistent results across all input combinations.
  • Validate financial report output for accuracy and auditability - understanding that errors in financial reporting output for a regulated enterprise client carry compliance implications, and treating data correctness accordingly.
  • Test report performance - validating that reports load within acceptable thresholds under representative data volumes, and flagging regressions in report responsiveness for investigation.
AI-Augmented Testing
  • Leverage AI tooling to generate test plans, test cases, edge cases, positive and negative scenarios, end-to-end scenarios, security scenarios, and test data sets - expanding coverage and accelerating test authoring.
  • Use AI tooling to accelerate the authoring of SQL validation queries, data comparison scripts, and report output test cases.
  • Continuously improve your use of AI tooling to raise the quality bar - using AI not just to work faster but to test more thoroughly than manual effort alone could achieve.
  • Stay current on emerging AI tooling relevant to QA - test generation, intelligent triage, data synthesis - and bring forward-looking recommendations to the Principal QA Lead and Sr Engineering Manager - QA Standards.
Automation Development Maintenance
  • Write and maintain automated test suites for the features and SQL changes you test - owning automation as an extension of your manual testing work.
  • Prioritize SQL-based data validation automation and API test coverage as the primary automation surfaces for this team; UI automation is secondary.
  • Make informed decisions on what to automate vs. what to test manually - balancing coverage value, maintenance cost, and delivery velocity.
  • Contribute to the shared automation framework and test infrastructure alongside peer QA Engineers - including SQL assertion patterns, API test coverage, and CI/CD pipeline integration via Azure DevOps.
  • Execute automated tests within CI/CD pipelines; triage failures to distinguish genuine defects from environmental noise.
  • Continuously improve automation coverage, reliability, and triage efficiency within the Reporting/BI team.
Security Testing
  • Incorporate security testing into your standard test approach - including input validation, authentication and authorization boundary testing, data exposure risks, and injection vulnerabilities in report parameters and API inputs.
  • Partner with engineers to identify security-sensitive areas of new reporting features and ensure appropriate security test coverage is included in test plans.
  • Leverage AI tooling to generate security-focused test scenarios and edge cases that manual analysis alone might miss.
  • Escalate identified security risks clearly and promptly to the scrum team, Principal QA Lead, and Sr Engineering Manager - QA Standards.
Collaboration Communication
  • Partner closely with the Lead Engineer and peer engineers to understand reporting implementations, SQL changes, and data model updates - flagging quality risks early and influencing design decisions that affect testability.
  • Collaborate with the Principal QA Lead and Sr Engineering Manager - QA Standards on test strategy, coverage standards, and process improvements.
  • Communicate defect status, test progress, data accuracy findings, and quality risks clearly to the scrum team and QA leadership.
  • Support junior QA Engineers through peer review, knowledge sharing on SQL-based data validation techniques, and mentorship.
  • Interface with client stakeholders as needed under the direction of the Lead Engineer - reporting issue clarification and defect evidence documentation.
Qualifications
Required

  • Hands-on experience writing SQL to validate data accuracy at the database layer - row counts, field-level correctness, aggregation logic, and relational integrity. This is the primary required skill for this role; Oracle experience strongly preferred.

And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Title: Manager II, Technical Scrum Lead
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
EY Technology:
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:
  • Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  • Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) - EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  • Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
The opportunity
This role leads a team providing agile methodology services to cross-functional technology-related project(s) or product(s) teams, demonstrating technical expertise to improve productivity of teams and quality of work processes and outcomes. Project(s) or product(s) often have enterprise-wide implications. This role also ensures agile best practices are embedded in delivery, manages stakeholder alignment, and drives team performance through metrics and continuous feedback.
Your key responsibilities
  • Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
  • Leads, builds, and coaches high performing teams in the delivery of technology-related products or projects, ensuring team actions are aligned with project and business goals. Instruct and coach other professionals.
  • Leads planning, team learning, and adaptation of processes to ensure the quality of team solutions.
  • Enables a continuous learning environment, identifying ways to strengthen the teams understanding of Agile/Scrum concepts and principles as they relate to technical capabilities.
  • Builds and applies methodology that supports the integration of changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology-related product development.
  • Recommends to the product owner and management in the definition and prioritization of technology-related outcomes. Identifies trade-offs between short and long term benefits to drive shared vision between the team and product owner.
  • Ensures the application of agile frameworks to the development process to increase effectiveness of technology-related product development or architecture.
  • Removes roadblocks to technology-related product development or architecture. Applies learnings to other development projects.
  • Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
  • Manages stakeholder expectations regarding target scope, schedule, and budget.
  • Helps teams estimate iteration deliverables and increase sprint velocity.
  • Acts as a Subject Matter Expert for agile methodologies and best practices.
  • Promotes continuous communication and monitors team dynamics to foster collaboration.
  • Facilitates scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, demos, and iteration meetings.
  • Manages development tracking systems (e.g., product and sprint backlogs).
  • Motivates and acts as the glue that holds cross-functional teams together.
  • Monitors sprint progress and identifies impediments that hinder delivery.
  • Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive monitoring and alerting to proactively identify performance degradation and application disruptions
  • Perform end to end triage and in depth troubleshooting of production incidents by analysing logs, telemetry signals, and related diagnostic data to quickly identify root causes and restore service
  • Design and build ML models that analyse telemetry, logs and metrics to predict and prevent incidents before they impact users.
  • Implement best in class detection mechanisms to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and accelerate incident response
  • Develop systems that learn from historical incidents, continuously improving diagnostic accuracy and accelerate incident response time
  • Build innovative, scalable alerting solutions across a heterogeneous technology landscape, including AWS, Unix, and Mainframe platforms.
  • Develop and maintain synthetic monitoring to simulate real user interactions and ensure early detection of failures.

jobDescription:
About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

The Junior Clinical Case Manager (Jr. CCM) operates as a vital link between direct clinical care and operational oversight within Lyra Health s mental health delivery model in India. This permanent position encompasses first-line helpline and crisis management, clinical intake triage, and the delivery of structured, workplace-focused short-term therapy. Beyond direct care, the role drives quality assurance and operational compliance by auditing clinical documentation, monitoring outcome metrics such as CORE-10, preventing clinical drift, and managing affiliate network relationships and onboarding. Requiring a Master s degree in Clinical or Counseling Psychology, three to six years of progressive clinical experience-preferably in EAP or corporate mental health environments-and fluency in English and Hindi, the Jr. CCM blends high-level clinical risk assessment with detail-oriented case management to ensure high quality, scalable care across the provider network.
Purpose of the Job:
To manage clinical operations, facilitate referrals, and monitor the quality of care delivered by the provider network.
It is a permanent position focused on operationalizing high-quality clinical care.

Working Hours: 48 hours per week.
Schedule: 5 or 6 days a week; various shifts may be applicable.
Hybrid Work: Hybrid working can be considered as per the need of the job.
Responsibilities:
1. Helpline Crisis Management
Serve as the primary first point of contact for employees and their dependents accessing the Lyra helpline via telephone, live chat, or email.
Provide immediate "in-the-moment" clinical support to callers in distress, utilizing psychological first aid and stabilization techniques.
Conduct comprehensive clinical risk assessments for every contact to identify potential self-harm, ideation, or risk to others, adhering to Lyra s established risk protocols.
Manage emergency interventions and coordinate with local emergency services or internal senior clinical leads when high-risk situations are identified.
2. Clinical Intake Triage
Conduct detailed clinical intake interviews to assess the user s presenting concerns, history, and level of psychological distress.
Evaluate the appropriateness of short-term counseling versus higher-acuity care pathways based on the clinical assessment.
Utilize internal decision-making frameworks to assign clients to the most suitable professional within the in-house team or the partner provider network, matching based on clinical specialty and language preference.
Accurately capture and document all clinical intake data, including CORE-10 scores and work impact metrics, in the database to ensure a seamless handover to the treating clinician.
3. Delivery of Clinical Sessions
Provide high-quality, professional counseling and psychotherapy sessions to clients within a structured, short-term framework.
Utilize evidence-based interventions (such as CBT or solution-focused therapy) to address client queries and specific mental health concerns.
Ensure all clinical sessions are workplace-focused when appropriate, helping the service user improve their level of functioning and productivity.
Maintain accurate, contemporaneous clinical notes for every session, ensuring they meet the legal and professional standards of the Indian healthcare landscape.
Monitor client progress through regular outcome measurement and adjust the treatment plan as necessary, or escalate to the Senior CCM for complex case review.
4. Documentation Oversight Quality Assurance
Conduct systematic monitoring of all active clinical cases from initiation to closure to ensure strict adherence to Lyra s clinical documentation standards.
Proactively follow up with internal clinicians and affiliate providers to secure missing or delayed clinical notes, treatment plans, and discharge summaries.
Audit case files for the accurate inclusion of outcome measurements, specifically tracking the consistent use of CORE-10 and work impact scores.
Ensure all clinical documentation is captured within the database in a timely manner, maintaining a high standard of data integrity for audit readiness.
Identify and escalate recurring documentation gaps to the Senior CCM to facilitate targeted provider training and performance management.
5. Affiliate Network Specialty Support
Serve as the primary point of operational contact for the partner provider network, offering continuous support regarding administrative and portal requirements.
Maintain and verify the accuracy of the affiliate database, ensuring all partner providers have professional, updated bios that reflect their current clinical expertise.
Routinely audit and update provider specialties and language proficiencies to ensure the intake team can perform precise referral matching.
Assist in the onboarding process by training new affiliates on Lyra s specific clinical protocols, risk management procedures, and case referral workflows.
Support partner providers in navigating cross-border referral processes and understanding local compliance nuances.
6. Protocol Adherence
Intervention Alignment: Rigorously audit treatment plans to ensure all clinical interventions align with Lyra s evidence-based, short-term, and solution-focused models.
Workplace Focus Integration: Evaluate clinical goals to ensure they are specifically designed to improve the service user s level of functioning within the workplace, focusing on "Work Impact" and productivity restoration.
Goal-Oriented Care: Verify that every treatment plan includes clear, measurable objectives that can be reasonably achieved within the prescribed short-term session limit.
Clinical Gatekeeping: Identify and address "clinical drift" where therapy may be deviating from the brief intervention framework or losing its workplace-centric focus.
Standardized Assessment Review: Monitor the consistent application of clinical outcome measures (such as CORE-10) to validate that the intervention protocol is resulting in measurable symptom reduction.
Provider Consultation: Provide direct feedback and consultation to partner providers when treatment plans do not meet Lyra s specific clinical protocols or service level agreements.
Case Escalation: Manage the transition of cases that require longer-term or higher-acuity care, ensuring the handover remains compliant with Lyra s global clinical standards and local professional guidelines.
7. Miscellaneous
Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra s core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy in every interaction with colleagues, providers, and service users.
Task Ownership Accountability: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Process Optimization Initiatives: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and take the initiative to propose and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency and clinical outcomes.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate seamlessly with the Clinical Lead, Client Success, and Product teams to ensure the delivery of the highest quality care to both clients (companies) and individual customers.
Workshop Delivery Training: Participate in opportunities to deliver onsite or online workshops and training sessions for client organizations as requested.
Content Creation: Contribute to the development of clinical content, training manuals, and affiliate-facing materials to maintain Lyra s position as a thought leader in mental health.
Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events, webinars, and industry conferences to promote Lyra s transformative care model and clinical research.
Experience:
Qualification: Masters in Clinical or Counseling Psychology; RCI registration is desirable.
Experience Level: 3-6 years of progressive working experience in a clinical setting.
Specialized Experience: Strong preference for candidates with a background in EAP or workplace mental health, particularly with work-impact cases.
Global Exposure: Experience navigating diverse healthcare systems and cultural nuances is preferred.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google Suite and CRM systems.
Linguistic Skills: Must be bilingual in Hindi and English.
About You:
Clinical Acumen: Strong clinical understanding with the ability to identify and assess clinical risk within a case management framework.
Problem Solver: Analytical approach to solving operational bottlenecks and navigating network challenges.
Autonomous Accountable: Able to manage individual caseload responsibilities and escalate clinical concerns accurately.
Detail-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail in monitoring clinical notes and auditing outcome measurements (CORE-10).
Communicator: Clear verbal and written skills for managing relationships with external providers and internal teams.
Proactive Adaptive: Continuous improvement mindset to refine referral and coordination processes.
Organized: Exceptional ability to prioritize operational tasks and meet reporting deadlines under pressure.
Collaborative: Collaborates effectively with internal stakeholders to achieve a seamless global account experience.

Job Description
The Escalation Manager is a specialized individual contributor role within the Global Support organization, responsible for owning and managing critical customer account escalations from onset through stabilization and closure. This role acts as the single point of accountability within Support for escalated accounts, ensuring issues are addressed with urgency, structure, and cross-functional alignment.
The EM s primary objective is to stabilize high-risk customer accounts by driving the resolution of critical issues, coordinating closely with Support, Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Product teams. This includes ensuring proper prioritization of P1 and high-impact cases, enforcing case hygiene, facilitating timely Engineering engagement, and ensuring that internal escalation paths are triggered proactively before the customer or Sales team raises concerns externally.
This role requires strong technical depth across ERP application architecture, infrastructure, and troubleshooting. The EM must be able to understand complex technical landscapes, challenge and guide resolution strategies, and hold teams accountable for progress. While not responsible for direct implementation or relationship management, the EM acts as the technical escalation leader for the account, ensuring a coordinated and transparent support response.
Beyond day-to-day escalation handling, the Escalation Manager plays a critical role in:
  • Identifying systemic or recurring issues contributing to account instability.
  • Driving and participating in account-level stabilization plans.
  • Engaging in post-escalation reviews to strengthen processes and prevent recurrence.
  • Ensuring clear and structured internal and external communication.
This is a high-visibility role requiring composure under pressure, strong cross-functional leadership without formal authority, and the ability to influence outcomes across multiple teams. Given the nature of escalated accounts, the position may require flexible working hours, on-call participation, and direct executive visibility.
Escalated Account Ownership:

Stabilization and Resolution Strategy:

Job Summary

Staff Analog Design Engineer, Automotive Networking - Hyderabad, India

The Automotive Networking Business Unit at Analog Devices, Inc. (ADI) is seeking an experienced Staff Analog Design Engineer to join its Hyderabad design team. In this P4 technical leadership role, you will architect and deliver high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for wired automotive connectivity, including Ethernet and related technologies. You will work across functions such as data converters, line drivers and receivers, clock generation, references, power distribution, signal conditioning, and input/output circuits.

You will have significant latitude to solve complex design problems, lead product, system, and block-level architectural decisions, and guide designs from requirements through tape-out, silicon validation, qualification, and production release. You will collaborate with global, cross-functional teams and mentor other engineers while helping to grow ADI's analog and mixed-signal design capability in Hyderabad.

Responsibilities

  • Technical leadership: Lead the definition and optimisation of complex analog and mixed-signal IC architectures, specifications, and implementation plans.
  • Circuit ownership: Design and deliver transistor-level circuits such as amplifiers, data converters, line drivers and receivers, references, clocking circuits, power-management functions, and analog interfaces.
  • Design and simulation: Develop circuit schematic and perform PVT, Monte Carlo, noise, stability, transient, and post-layout analyses; resolve complex performance, reliability, and integration issues.
  • Layout direction: Collaborate with layout engineers on floorplanning, matching, parasitics, isolation, signal integrity, electromigration, and other critical physical-design considerations.
  • Product execution: Drive designs to tape-out readiness and support silicon bring-up, laboratory characterisation, debug, production test, qualification, yield improvement, and release to volume production.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work with product definition, systems, digital design, design verification, layout, process, test, applications, quality, and manufacturing teams to meet product and business objectives.
  • Engineering trade-offs: Lead technical decisions across performance, power, area, cost, schedule, reliability, electromagnetic compatibility, and manufacturability.
  • Mentoring and reviews: Provide technical guidance, conduct rigorous design reviews, share best practices, and support the development of less experienced engineers.
  • Innovation and customer impact: Contribute new circuit and system concepts, support technical customer engagements, and help shape future automotive networking products.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Platform reliability - monitoring, SLAs, incident management, and operational runbooks so the platform runs as a production service.

title: Senior Product Owner
tagsAndSkills: Product Evaluation,Product Management,AI/ML,Backlog Refinement,Acceptance Criteria,Product Planning,Evaluation,Artificial Intelligence
jobDescription:
You will own the behaviour of a specific AI system or workflow inside a larger product. You will work with a team and a defined set of internal stakeholders. Your primary stakeholders are business teams who will use the workflow and engineering teams who will build it. You will be responsible for creating a spec that the business teams can approve and engineering teams can build efficiently. Your success is measured by whether the AI system behaves as specified in production over time.


You will work with QA and engineering to build and review evaluations. This is a critical part of the role. Evaluations are how you verify the AI system keeps behaving as specified once it's live.


Building a working understanding of how AI systems work, and what that means for product and analytics, is critical to this role. You will also act as a proxy for the business team and run UAT.


Alongside that, the role carries the usual weight of product ownership: picking up an unfamiliar domain fast, holding the line on scope, and keeping stakeholders aligned on what is shipping and when.


What you will own

Backlog and delivery

  • Own and prioritise the backlog for your system; run refinement, planning, and acceptance with the delivery team. You could also be running kanban boards for your team for a fast paced project.
  • Turn business requirements into AI system requirements for the engineering team.
  • The requirements should meet the Jeavio guardrails of AI governance, privacy, security and responsible AI standards, and highlight it when a requirement falls outside them.
  • Support adoption: training, workflow changes, review Evals, user manuals, release notes etc. that might be required to get the feature to production.

PO Competency

  • Pick up a new domain quickly and get to the point where you can ask informed questions about the business.
  • Should be able to adopt AI tools like Claude or similar to work upon eliciting and/or prototyping requirements (including UX designs) independently or collaboratively with technical peers.
  • Should be able to participate in and lead (where appropriate) discovery sessions to be able to understand the lay of the land, vision and translate it back into documentation that can be used by both the business and engineering teams.
  • You should be able to figure out which are the relevant metrics for users and business.
  • AI can be more accurate but slower, more flexible but less predictable, cheaper but occasionally wrong. You should be able to weigh tradeoffs from a product point of view - i.e. whether a certain trade off is okay or breaks user experience.
  • The Evals you define must align with the product requirements.

Stakeholder Management

  • Steer stakeholders towards the better option or push back on scope during scope based negotiations by working alongside the engineering team.
  • Be able to influence the roadmap by understanding what the team can deliver vs what the stakeholders want.
  • Should also be able to present project status to stakeholders and give an update on delivery timelines by aligning with the technical teams.
  • Should be able to understand and communicate the limitations of the system, clearly to stakeholders.

Behavioural specification

  • Write acceptance criteria for probabilistic outputs.
  • Work with Engineering and QA colleagues to define system guardrails
  • Specify the confidence thresholds that trigger human review, a fallback path, or a graceful exit.
  • Read and assess system prompts well enough to tell whether they match the spec.
  • Write the spec for two readers at once: the AI engineer who implements it and the business user who will live with it.

Evaluation and human oversight

  • Own the evaluation dataset for your system across its lifecycle.
  • Interpret results and translate them for non technical stakeholders.

Security & Compliance:

  • Define and prioritize security requirements in product backlog
  • Ensure data protection, privacy, and compliance with ISO 27001 policies
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams for secure product delivery
  • Manage risks related to features, integrations, and data handling
  • Support audit readiness and continuous security improvements

What we are looking for

Required

  • 6+ years in product ownership, product management, or business analysis, including at least two years owning a backlog with a delivery team.
  • Direct experience shipping or operating an AI/ML or LLM-based feature in production not only prototyping.
  • Fluency in AI tools - ChatGPT or Claude including an understanding of skills, plugins, and context management.
  • Demonstrable understanding of how LLMs work and how they impact product decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to write acceptance criteria for a non-deterministic output.
  • Working fluency in Evals.
  • Judgment about where human in the loop use case fits in.
  • Strong written communication.
  • Should be able to keep up with evolving trends and is open to unlearn and learn quickly.

Good to have

  • Experience with agentic systems: tool use, multi-step orchestration, retrieval, or observability tooling.
  • Familiarity with our stack: AWS, Claude, LangSmith, JIRA.

Design and develop ABAP solutions optimized for SAP HANA using pushdown principles (minimize data movement, maximize in database processing).

Design reusable data artifacts that support downstream consumers (UI, integrations, analytics, and AI retrieval layers).
Ensure lineage-friendly structures and consistent business definitions to reduce ambiguity across systems.

oTool calling orchestration (LLM triggers approved SAP actions via controlled APIs)
oRetrieval grounded outputs (RAG style grounding) over governed SAP data and documentation
oDeterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak or confidence is low
Implement prompts/templates, tool schemas, and context assembly strategies that reduce hallucinations and enforce enterprise safety boundaries.

Build automated tests (unit/integration/contract) for ABAP services and data artifacts enforce regression coverage for performance and correctness.
Establish evaluation harnesses for AI behaviors:offline golden datasets, scenario-based tests, and online monitoring to detect drift/regressions.
Introduce guardrails for AI outputs:authorization-aware context filtering, redaction rules, action confirmations, and audit logs.

Instrument services and critical logic with logs/metrics/traces suitable for production support and root-cause analysis.
Design robust error handling for enterprise flows:retries, idempotency, correlation IDs, and safe failure modes.
Support incident response with runbooks and structured diagnostics continuously harden solutions based on observed failure patterns.

Integrate ABAP on HANA services with SAP and non SAP ecosystems (event-driven patterns, API gateways, enterprise integration layers).
Collaborate with UX, integration, data, and platform teams to ensure end to end solution correctness and performance.
Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in.

Experience with AMDP / SQLScript for performance critical scenarios and controlled code pushdown.
Solid software engineering discipline:clean design, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation, and production readiness.
AI native build capability:LLM integration, retrieval grounding, tool orchestration, evaluation loops, and safety boundaries.

Training or fine tuning foundation models from scratch.
AI assisted only development this role builds and owns AI behaviors (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability) as part of SAP solution delivery.

High performance SAP solutions through HANA optimized ABAP engineering and disciplined pushdown design.

About The Role  

Entity:- Accenture Strategy Consulting

Team:- Strategy Consulting Global Network

Title:- Consultant/ Manager/Analyst Marketing Customer Data Platforms (GCP, CDP, Agentic AI)

Job location:- Any out of 6 AI locations

About SC - Global Network (GN) :- Accenture GNs Data AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling to outperform the competition.

WHATS IN IT FOR YOU

As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.

What you would do in this role

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.



Key Duties and Responsibilities:(GCP CDP)
  • Architect Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Build Production-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability.
  • Model for Insight Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics.
  • Champion DevOps MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager.
  • Deploy Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms.
  • Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference.
  • Collaborate Innovate: Work within a multi-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering.
  • Ensure Governance Security: Implement solutions that adhere to data governance best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), ensuring data is handled securely and ethically.


    • Key Duties and Responsibilities:(RTCDP)
  • Be a platform expert in Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Real time CDP). Developer level expertise on Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Experience Platform) is a must with other CDP platforms like Lytics, Segment, Amperity, Tealium, Treasure Data etc. including custom build CDPs as an added advantage
  • Deep developer level expertise for real time event tracking for web analytics e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, etc.
  • Provide deep domain expertise in our clients business and broad knowledge of digital marketing together with a Marketing Strategist industry
  • Deep expert level knowledge of reporting tools like GA360/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
  • Deep expert level knowledge of paid media destinations - Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc.
  • Deep developer expertise for Journey Orchestration and Personalization tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer
  • Assess and audit the current state of a clients marketing technology stack (MarTech) including data infrastructure, ad platforms and data security policies together with a solutions architect.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews and gather business requirements
  • Translate business requirements into BRDs, CDP customer analytics use cases, structure technical solution
  • Prioritize CDP use cases together with the client.
  • Create a strategic CDP roadmap focused on data driven marketing activation.
  • Work with the Solution Architect to strategize, architect, and document a scalable CDP/Martech implementation, tailored to the clients needs. Able to integrate multiple Martech tools.
  • Ensure analytics are consistently implemented across digital properties. Diagnose and troubleshoot analytics/Martech implementation and platform configuration issues. Perform end-to-end QA testing for integrations.
  • Coordinate with website developers for Analytics integration, datalayer implementation, Martech tools integration
  • Design and Implement Adobe Stack Martech tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
  • Deep domain expertise in Tag Management, Journey Orchestration, Campaign Management, A/B Testing
  • Perform technical analysis design for Martech related initiatives. Define requirements for Martech implementation/reporting dashboard.


    • Key Duties and Responsibilities:(Agentic AI)
  • Architect the core interaction logic and decision-making frameworks for enterprise-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP.
  • Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities.
  • Design agentic AI systems for scalability, robustness, and real-time responsiveness in autonomous marketing decision-making.
  • Design and implement data storage strategies (Datastores) optimized for efficient retrieval of context for AI agents.
  • Design, implement, and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to equip Gemini agents with contextually relevant information from various knowledge sources.
  • Leverage Gemini models'' reasoning capabilities to enable agents for complex analysis, strategic planning, and problem-solving in marketing contexts.
  • Develop and apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance the reasoning, accuracy, and output quality of AI agents.
  • Implement and leverage grounding evaluation capabilities within Agentic AI systems to ensure outputs are factually accurate, contextually relevant, and traceable to specific data sources for marketing applications.
  • Develop and deploy AI-driven solutions for generating multimodal marketing assets (e.g., personalized images, video snippets, audio messages) powered by Gemini.
  • Implement LLMops best practices for the lifecycle management of agentic AI models, including CI/CD for AI components.
  • Ensure secure and compliant interactions for AI agents, managing credentials and secrets relevant to AI model access.
  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and observability specifically for the performance, decision paths, and output quality of agentic AI systems.
  • Prototype new approaches and provide expert guidance on GCP AI services, Gemini, RAG, advanced prompting, and reasoning AI techniques.
  • Create insights presentations and client-ready decks, effectively communicating findings and recommendations.

Summary
You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Production Planning (PP) processes for discrete manufacturing environments while using AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. The role focuses on delivering efficient production planning, shop floor execution, and material staging processes while integrating pre built AI services where beneficial. No deep AI model engineering, vector DB work, RAG, or agentic system development is required.


Key Responsibilities
Functional Technical Delivery
Configure and support SAP PP processes including:
oMaterial Requirement Planning (MRP)
oProduction Orders Execution
oRoutings, Work Centers BOM Management
oCapacity Planning Scheduling
oBackflushing Costing Integration
oGoods Movements Shop floor Reporting
Use AI copilots to accelerate:
oFunctional specification creation
oRouting/BOM validation
oTest case generation for MRP, order creation, confirmations
oDocumentation automation (FS/TS/SOPs)
Support full lifecycle delivery:requirements, design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, hypercare support.
Integrate PP with MM, QM, SD, FI/CO, and shop floor systems (MES), leveraging standard APIs and middleware.
AI Assisted Productivity
Use AI copilots for:
oAutomated summarization of requirements and change impacts
oAnalysis of MRP exceptions and planning alerts
oValidation of order execution and production variances
oFaster defect isolation in BOM/routing/work center configurations
Integrate pre built AI services into production workflows, such as:
oPredictive insights (e.g., potential material shortages or order delays)
oIntelligent classification of production issues
oAutomated summarization of production batch deviations
oSmart suggestions based on historical production performance
Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce time spent analyzing MRP exception messages, order failures, and material shortages.
Governance, Quality Collaboration
Ensure compliance with production governance, change controls, data accuracy standards, and audit policies.
Participate in workshops, solution reviews, and process optimization discussions enhanced by AI generated insights.
Collaborate with production, quality, warehouse, procurement, cost controlling, and integration teams to deliver end to end planning excellence.
Create reusable templates, checklists, test packs, and AI enabled best practices for SAP PP delivery.

Required Skills Experience
SAP PP Expertise
Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes including BOM/routing management, production order cycles, capacity planning, scheduling, and MRP.
Experience with integration across MM (material availability), QM (inspection lots), SD (demand), and FI/CO (costing).
Familiarity with order confirmations, settlements, and shop floor data capture processes.
AI Ready Skills
Ability to use AI copilots, automated documentation tools, and AI assisted test accelerators.
Comfortable embedding pre built AI capabilities into production planning or execution (not custom model building).
Awareness of responsible AI usage and limitations in manufacturing and planning environments.
General Professional Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to production variability, MRP outcomes, and resource planning.
Ability to translate manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP PP configurations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and operational teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

Good to Have
SAP PP Certification (S/4HANA Manufacturing).
Experience with MES systems, shop floor integrations, or IoT enabled production data.
Exposure to EWM/WM, PM, or APO/IBP environments.
Familiarity with automated testing tools (Tricentis, CBTA).

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more reliable SAP PP solutions using AI enabled productivity tools.
Improve planning accuracy, resource utilization, and production stability.
Act as a bridge between manufacturing teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native experts when deeper AI capabilities are required.

A 15 years full time education is required.

SAP Datasphere is positioned as a data warehousing solution with integration capabilities.
Core Responsibilities
1) AI Native Data Product Engineering (on Datasphere)
Design and implement governed data products using Datasphere concepts such as Spaces and shareable models/views, enabling teams to explore, transform, and share curated datasets across domains.

Embed quality controls, validation checks, and reproducible transformations as part of the delivery lifecycle.
5) Agentic Orchestration Tooling
Build data agents that can plan, call tools (query/metadata/lineage), retrieve context, and generate answers with citationsbacked by deterministic checks and fallback behaviors.
Implement prompt templates, tool schemas, and safe action boundaries for enterprise-grade usage.
6) Evaluation, Observability Responsible AI
Establish offline/online evaluation loops (golden questions, regression suites, behavior tests) for conversational analytics and data agents.
Add telemetry for AI interactions (latency, grounding rate, failure modes) to improve reliability and cost efficiency.

Drive reusable patterns and accelerators for repeatable delivery across domains.

tagsAndSkills: data engineering,Scratch,data modeling,AI,workflow management,data orchestration,ETL,distributed data processing
jobDescription:
• Startup / Data Orchestration Platform

About the Role

  • We are a startup building a data orchestration platform, and data is at the core of our business.
  • We are looking for a highly capable, forward-thinking Lead Data Engineer who can help shape our data engineering journey from the ground up.
  • This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys building from scratch, thinking through complexity, solving challenging problems, and making critical architectural decisions.
  • We are looking for an individual who can take ownership of our data engineering foundation and help define how data powers our platform and business as we scale.
  • We are looking for a builder, problem-solver, and technical thinkernot just someone who executes predefined tasks.
  • The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with critical thinking, design capabilities, excellent articulation, and a forward-looking perspective on AI.

What You Will Own

  • Shape and build the company's data engineering foundation from scratch.
  • Define the data architecture, engineering practices, and long-term technical direction.
  • Translate complex business problems into scalable, reliable, and maintainable data solutions.
  • Design and build data pipelines, orchestration workflows, and data processing systems.
  • Establish data quality, validation, observability, and governance practices.
  • Make architectural decisions that balance immediate business needs with long-term scalability.
  • Work closely with the founders, product, and engineering teams to connect business requirements with technical solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI in data engineering, orchestration, automation, and platform capabilities.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of the data engineering function as the company grows.

What We Are Looking For

  • Core Thinking & Problem-Solving Skills These are critical selection criteria, alongside technical expertise.
  • Problem Solver: Ability to break down ambiguous, challenging problems and develop practical solutions.
  • Critical Thinking: Evaluate trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and make sound technical decisions.
  • Design Thinking: Ability to design systems and architectures that address complex requirements.
  • Connect the Dots: Understand relationships between data, systems, business requirements, and product capabilities.
  • Handle Complexity: Comfort working through uncertainty, evolving requirements, and interconnected technical challenges.
  • Good Articulation: Clearly communicate ideas, architectural decisions, technical trade-offs, and complex concepts.
  • Forward-Looking Mindset: Understand emerging technologies and identify opportunities to incorporate AI into data engineering and platform development.
  • Ownership: Take responsibility for shaping the data function and driving outcomes independently.

Technical Skills & Experience

  • 8-10 years of relevant data engineering experience preferred.
  • Strong experience in designing and building data platforms, pipelines, and architectures.
  • Experience building data engineering solutions from scratch, rather than working exclusively on established systems.
  • Strong understanding of data orchestration, workflow management, and distributed data processing.
  • Experience with data modeling, data integration, transformation, and processing.
  • Expertise in designing scalable, reliable, and maintainable data systems.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, observability, performance optimization, and system reliability.
  • Experience with cloud-based data infrastructure and modern data engineering technologies.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered engineering tools, AI-assisted workflows, and emerging AI capabilities in data platforms.

Preferred Background

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth product company.
  • Prior experience building a data platform, data engineering function, or significant data infrastructure from scratch.
  • Experience working in an early-stage environment where architecture, technical direction, and engineering practices need to be established.
  • Exposure to data orchestration platforms or complex data-intensive products.
  • Experience working closely with founders and product teams to translate business vision into technical execution.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Someone who: Enjoys solving problems without always having a predefined answer.
  • Can think deeply about architecture, design, and system complexity.
  • Is comfortable taking ownership and making decisions in an evolving startup environment.
  • Can connect business needs with technical possibilities.
  • Thinks beyond immediate implementation and considers the future of the platform.
  • Is curious about how AI can change the way data systems are designed and built.
  • Wants to create something meaningful from the ground up.

Why Join Us

  • This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the data engineering journey of a startup where data orchestration is central to the product.
  • You will have the opportunity to influence architecture, establish engineering foundations, solve meaningful technical challenges, and help define how the platform evolves.
  • If you are someone who loves building from scratch, thinking through complexity, and shaping the future of data with AI, we would love to connect with you.
